tool.smart_list.title: List SMART Disks
tool.smart_list.description: Read-only listing of local block devices smartctl can probe (name / type / info). Data source is `smartctl --scan`; each line parses to {name, type, info}. If smartmontools is not installed, returns an empty list with a note instead of erroring.
tool.smart_health.title: Disk SMART Health
tool.smart_health.description: Read-only SMART health of one disk via `smartctl -H`. `passed` is the combined verdict (text status + bitmask bit 3). `exit_bitmask` is the raw smartctl exit code — smartctl 7.x exit codes are a BITMASK, not an error code; bit 3 = DISK FAILING (authoritative), bit 4 = prefail attr at threshold, bit 6 = device error log records, etc. See `note` for a human-readable translation.
tool.smart_attributes.title: Disk SMART Attributes
tool.smart_attributes.description: Read-only SMART key attributes via `smartctl -A`: temperature, cumulative power-on hours, reallocated sectors, pending sectors, offline uncorrectable, and (for NVMe) available spare, percentage used, media/data integrity errors, error log entries, power cycles, unsafe shutdowns. Supports ATA and NVMe.
tool.smart_test.title: SMART Self-Test
tool.smart_test.description: SMART self-test placeholder. **L1 deferred in this release**: this tool triggers NO disk I/O and returns `started=false` with an explanatory note. SMART self-tests require a y/n confirmation token (daedalus-tx/confirm_token) to avoid accidental long-running operations; daedalus.smart is a read-only observation plugin and does not integrate that gate. Callers should NOT assume the disk has been self-tested.
